title: A blow when someone is bowed down
odia:
ନଇଁ ପଡିଥିବ ଯେତିକି ବେଳେ
ବିଧାଏ ମାରିବ ସେତିକି ବେଳେ।
literal_meaning: Just when someone is bent down, give them a punch.
meaning_odia: କେହି ନଇଁ ପଡ଼ିଥିବା ବେଳକୁ ବିଧାଏ ମାରିବାର ଚିତ୍ର ଏଠାରେ ଅଛି। ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ପାଠରେ ଅନ୍ୟର ଦୁର୍ବଳ ଅବସ୍ଥାକୁ ସୁଯୋଗ କରି ଆଉ ଆଘାତ ଦେବାକୁ ଏହା ବୁଝାଏ। ଏପରି ବ୍ୟବହାରକୁ ଚିହ୍ନାଇବା ପାଇଁ କଥାଟି ଉଦ୍ଧୃତ ହୋଇପାରେ; ଏହା ଆମ ପକ୍ଷରୁ ଆଘାତ ଦେବାର ପରାମର୍ଶ ନୁହେଁ।
explanation: The two halves make the timing exact: the blow lands when the other person is already bowed down. Our editorial reading concerns taking advantage of vulnerability to add another injury. The directive shape of the line can expose that conduct when quoted critically.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A person already struggling with a setback faces someone who deliberately chooses that moment to add pressure. An observer recalls the punch timed to a bowed posture.
cultural_context: The repeated time phrases ଯେତିକି ବେଳେ and ସେତିକି ବେଳେ connect weakness and attack tightly. The physical image makes the chosen moment, rather than the size of the blow, central.
